title: TaskCancel v1
description: hub->runner: graceful cancellation of a task at an automaton boundary. seq places it in the hub's per-task outbound stream so it is replayed on reconnect if the runner had not yet applied it. reason is an open, human-readable string.

reason.description: Why the task is being cancelled (open string).

seq.description: Sequence number in the hub's per-task outbound stream.
